question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the sentence.

He purchased very __cheap__ dresses.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cheap"** means something that is low in price or cost; it could refer to items that are affordable or inexpensive. (सस्ता)

 
 
• **Example: **He purchased very** cheap **dresses from the sale.
 
 
 
• **"Expensive" **refers to something that has a high price or cost; it is the opposite of cheap and implies a significant financial expenditure. (महंगा)
 
 
• **Example: **The designer dresses were too **expensive** for her budget.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'cheap' **is **'expensive'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Doltish **(मूर्ख): Lacking in intelligence or common sense.

 
 
• **Example:** His** doltish** behavior often got him into trouble.
 
 
 
• **Paltry **(तुच्छ): Very small or meager; not worth considering.
 
 
• **Example: **The **paltry** amount of money he offered was insulting.
 
 
 
• **Lively** (जीवंत): Full of life and energy; active and outgoing.
 
 
• **Example:** The party was** lively** and everyone had a great time.
